_comment: Shared by the site and scripts/render-samples.mjs. Add a voice here and the render script picks it up automatically. voice_id values must exist in services/tts/src/gotiny/tts/config/voices.yaml. Each prompt has a label (what the line is FOR — shown on the chip) and the text itself.
